title: Fix `dict2constraint` so that it can read `FixLine` and `FixPlane` made before ASE 3.23.0 again (Closes #1720)
body:
Closes #1720

Between ASE 3.22.0 and 3.23.0, the name of the argument for the indices of `FixedLine` and `FixedPlane` has been renamed from `a` to `indices` (which itself is OK in the sense that it is more consistent with the present parent `IndexedConstraint`) (!2418).
This however has broken the backward-compatibility, i.e., a trajectory file with these constraints made before ASE 3.23.0 cannot presently read by newer versions of ASE.
The present MR suggests to fix this by renaming the old `a` the new `indices` in `dict2constraint`.

comments.body: Can we take a copy before we mutate?  Maybe it's paranoid but I have seen some tricky bugs due to encoding/decoding that unexpectedly affected some of the objects involved.

comments.body: Thank you @askhl for the review and the suggestion! I agree that taking a copy is safer and hope the added commit will fix the tricky bugs.
